info.name: RhythmX Intelligence API
info.description: Import this collection into Postman and set the rhythmxApi collection variable to the FastAPI base URL. Historical chat requests require DATABASE_URL and valid athlete data. All model responses stream as text/plain.

request.description: Returns 200 only when the TimescaleDB/PostgreSQL connection is configured and reachable. Returns 503 when it is not configured or unavailable.

item.name: Historical chat and trends
item.description: These requests call POST /chat/. They stream a plain-text response. Replace athleteId with an athlete that exists in the configured database.

request.description: Trend Service retrieves the latest recovery score per day, builds a compact analytics payload, then invokes rhythmx-chat.

item.name: Readiness - current week versus prior week
Current-day intelligence engines
item.description: The curl samples label these paths with an external AI-service base URL. In this repository, the FastAPI gateway exposes them as /intelligence/{engine_type} under rhythmxApi.
